subject: [PATCH v6 03/19] selftests/mm: scale khugepaged's collapse wait with the PMD size

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adjusts the timeout for khugepaged's collapse wait to be proportional to the size of the PMD (Page Map Directory). The original three-second timeout was deemed too short for large PMDs, leading to false failures in some cases. The new approach scales the timeout by adding one second for every 128M bytes collapsed, ensuring that larger PMDs have a longer wait time. This change is expected to improve test reliability and accuracy.
